summary.en: The sheet slides off the mat downward and the next is dealt on from below, square to the reading position.
summary.zh: 这张纸向下滑出垫板，下一张从下方发上来，端正停在阅读位置。

fits: The ordinary page change of an evidence film; an index card arriving.

intent.en: Change the evidence without moving the camera: one sheet out, the next dealt on where the eye already is.
intent.zh: 不动镜头换证据：一张出去，下一张发到视线已经在的地方。

fits.zh: 证据片里普通的换页；索引卡的到来。

en: The out-move is faster than the in-move; never both sheets square at once.
zh: 出去比进来快；两张纸不会同时端正停着。

source.path: the dossier source film dealY, exitY; choreo.js deal

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
